name: Sindhi Ajrak shawl
about: A block-printed cotton shawl made in Sindh, using natural dyes and hand-carved wooden blocks. It is a traditional craft of the Sindh region, which includes Karachi.
tip: Ask whether the colors are hand-dyed or machine-printed, and check for bleeding by looking at the back of the fabric.

name: Karachi halwa
about: A sweet, sticky confection from Sindh, made with sugar, starch, ghee, and nuts. It is a well-known local treat that people in Karachi often bring home as a gift.
tip: Check the production date and the nut content before you buy, especially if you have allergies.
